title: List the superpowers of the tallest superhero who has the highest intellige
question: List the superpowers of the tallest superhero who has the highest intelligence attribute among all heroes taller than 180 cm.

prediction.sql:
SELECT sp.XCL_031
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.XCL_013 = sp.XCL_030
WHERE s.XCL_018 = (
    SELECT s2.XCL_018
    FROM superhero s2
    JOIN hero_attribute ha2 ON s2.XCL_018 = ha2.XCL_009
    JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.XCL_010 = a2.XCL_003
    WHERE s2.XCL_028 > 180
      AND a2.XCL_004 = 'Intelligence'
    ORDER BY ha2.XCL_011 DESC, s2.XCL_028 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
